title: Render worksheet JSON to HTML
goal: Render canonical worksheet JSON into student and teacher HTML without external dependencies in exported files.
context: HTML is the default export and should be generated from validated worksheet JSON.
acceptance: Teacher answer key HTML snapshot test exists
Renderer supports section headers, numbered questions, answer boxes, tables, and multiple-choice bubbles
Exported HTML is semantic and contains no external runtime dependencies
notes: Keep print behavior in CSS, not a separate content path.
